يرتجلن (form VIII)
# يَرْتَجِلْنَ (yartajilna) /jar.ta.d͡ʒil.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَجَلَ (irtajala)
# يُرْتَجَلْنَ (yurtajalna) /jur.ta.d͡ʒal.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَجَلَ (irtajala)
